info.description:

**Configuration Module**
**Module:** `Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-apf-cfg`
**Paths:** 2

put.description: Create or replace AP functionality configuration data

patch.description: Partially modify AP functionality configuration data

put.description: Create or replace AP functionality configuration

call-index.description: Index in database for preferred call number

dot11-country-code.description: This field configures the country of operation

system-mgmt-via-wireless.description: This field enables management access from wireless clients

blacklist-dot1x-timeout.description: This flag specifies if client should be excluded (blacklisted) if repeated 802.1x Authentication Timeout occurs with a client.

blacklist-dot1x-auth.description: This flag specifies if client should be excluded (blacklisted) if repeated 802.1x Authentication Failures occurs with a client.

blacklist-dot11-assoc.description: This flag specifies if client should be excluded (blacklisted) if repeated 802.11 Association Failures occurs with a client.

blacklist-ip-theft.description: This flag specifies if client should be excluded (blacklisted) if it appears to be reusing an IP Address.(Possible IP Theft)

blacklist-web-auth.description: This flag specifies if client should be excluded (blacklisted) if repeated Web Authentication Failures occurs with a client.

blacklist-failed-qos-policy.description: This flag specifies if client should be excluded (blacklisted) due to failed qos policy

probe-limit.description: This value indicates probe request limit

probe-interval.description: This value indicates probe request interval

max-user-logins.description: This attribute specifies the maximum number of concurrent logins that the switch will allow for a single user. A value 0 implies that there is no restriction on the number of concurrent logins with a single username.

web-auth-max-retries.description: Value specifies Maximum number of WebAuth request retries

dot1x-eapol-key-max-retries.description: Value specifies Maximum number of EAPOL key retries

dot1x-eapol-key-timeout.description: value specify EAPOL key retransmission timeout in milliseconds

dot1x-eap-id-request-retries.description: Value specify maximum number of EAP ID request retransmissions

dot1x-eap-id-request-timeout.description: Value specify EAP ID request-timeout value in seconds

dot1x-eap-request-max-retries.description: Maximum number of EAP request retransmissions

dot1x-eap-request-timeout.description: EAP request retransmission timeout value in seconds

dot1x-eap-broadcast-interval.description: EAP-broadcast key renew interval time in seconds

probe-filter.description: Configure filtering of probe requests from AP

assisted-roam-floor-bias.description: Configures RSSI bias default for same floor APs

assisted-roam-max-denial.description: Configures maximum number of times for association denial

assisted-roam-min-prediction.description: Configures minimum number of optimized APs for assisted-roaming prediction to work

spam-authorize-aps-mac.description: Configures an AP authorization policy with mac

spam-authorize-aps-serial-num.description: Configures an AP authorization policy with serial number

spam-authorize-aps-method-list.description: Configures an AP authorization policy with specified method list

dot1x-login-count-check.description: Configure to ignore the same username count reaching max in the EAP identity response

dedicated-to-xor-rssi-threshold.description: Configures macro to micro transition RSSI

xor-to-dedicated-rssi-threshold.description: Configures micro-macro client load balancing window

xor-roam-min-client-count.description: Configures macro-micro minimum client count for transition

balancing-window.description: Configures micro-macro client load balancing window

xor-probe-suppress-hysteresis.description: Configures probe cycles to be suppressed[ RSSI in dBm]

xor-probe-suppress-aggression.description: Configures probe cycles to be suppressed [Number of cycles]

fra-state.description: Enable/Disable Fra on all Cisco APs

led-brightness-level.description:
Configure AP LED brightness level.
         On modifying the global configuration,
         All AP's supporting LED brightness will be configured with
         global configured value.
         Represents following values.
         1 - 8 LED brightness level.

locally-administered-mac.description:
Enable the reporting of the probes
         from clients using locally administered
         MAC address

tri-radio-mode.description:
Tri radio mode configuration:
         False - tri-radio mode is disabled
         True - tri-radio mode is enabled

spam-authorize-aps-calling-id.description: Configures an AP authorization policy using the calling id

ap-audit-report.description:
AP audit report configuration:
         False - AP audit reporting disabled
         True - AP audit reporting enabled

vlan-persistent.description: Enable client roaming across different policy profiles

is-priming-ctrlr.description: Enable/disable this controller as priming controller

fra-freeze.description: Enable/Disable FRA Freeze on all Cisco APs

mac-mlist.description: Method list for AP MAC authorization

serial-no-mlist.description: Method list for AP serial number authorization

client-steering-cnt.description: Minimum number of clients for 6Ghz client steering

client-steering-win-size.description: Minimum 2.4/5Ghz to 6Ghz client count difference to steer client

client-steering-util-thres.description: Maximum 2.4/5Ghz to 6Ghz channel utilization difference to steer client

client-steering-rssi-24.description: Minimum 2.4Ghz received RSSI threshold to steer client

client-steering-rssi-5.description: Minimum 5Ghz received RSSI threshold to steer client

fra-56ghz-state.description: Enable/Disable FRA on all Cisco APs for XOR 5/6GHz

fra-56ghz-freeze.description: Enable/Disable 5/6GHz FRA Freeze on all APs

call-index.description: Index in database for preferred call number

upgrade-method-https.description: HTTPS configuration for AP image upgrade
